description: Source code implementing NEON-accelerated precoding functions for complex signal processing in a wireless communication context, including conversion between data formats, layer mapping, and precoding application.

classes.name: simd_cf_t
classes.description: Represents a set of complex numbers using NEON registers for real and imaginary parts.

methods.name: set1
methods.description: Sets the NEON registers with a complex constant.

methods.name: operator+
methods.description: Adds two interleaved complex number sets.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Multiplies a set of complex numbers by a complex weight.

methods.name: add_mul
methods.description: Performs combined addition and multiplication on complex number sets.

methods.name: cf_to_cbf16
methods.description: Converts interleaved complex float data to 16-bit complex bitfield format.

methods.name: apply_precoding_port
methods.description: Applies precoding weights to input RE data and outputs port-referenced complex bitfield data.

methods.name: from_ci8_to_ci16
methods.description: Converts 8-bit interleaved input data to 16-bit format.

methods.name: from_ci32_to_cf
methods.description: Converts 32-bit integer data to floating point complex format.

methods.name: from_ci8_to_cf
methods.description: Converts 8-bit input symbols into complex float format across multiple NEON registers.

methods.name: layer2_map_and_ci8_to_cf
methods.description: Performs layer mapping and converts 2-layer CI8 data to complex float format.

methods.name: layer3_map_and_ci8_to_cf
methods.description: Performs layer mapping and converts 3-layer CI8 data to complex float format.

methods.name: layer4_map_and_ci8_to_cf
methods.description: Performs layer mapping and converts 4-layer CI8 data to complex float format.

methods.name: template_apply_layer_map_and_precoding< NofPorts >
methods.description: Template function applying layer mapping and precoding for a specified number of ports.

methods.name: apply_layer_map_and_precoding
methods.description: Public method applying layer mapping and precoding using the template function.
